Rabbit Rearing - male - buck, female - doe
Choice of rabbit for rearing
Ability to grow rapidly.
A good converter of food into body weight.
Ability to resist diseases (disease resistant).
Ability to give birth to many young ones in a litter.
Good quality hides and skin.

Leaf

Meaning of poultry

Traditional method
Modern method
Importance of poultry
Source of income
Provision of eggs
Provision of meat
Provision of raw materials
Provision of poultry manure
Game (bird like parrot, ostrich and chicken are used for games to entertain people).

Types of chicken
Eggs laying chicken
Table meat chicken
Dual purpose chicken (for egg and meat production)
Selection of housing and equipment
Concrete building
Wooden and metal cages/wooden shed
Feeds
Chicks mash (2 months - 4 months, about 8 weeks)
Growers mash (2 months - 4 months, about 8 - 16 weeks)
Broiler starter (for meat producer only about 9 - 14 weeks)
Layers mash (for more eggs)
Source of old chicks
Housing system of poultry keeping:
Free range system
Semi intensive system
Intensive system - i. The fold system ii. The deep litter system iii. The Battery cage

Sign of ill - health in chicken
Roughened feathers,
Discharge from the nostril
Mucorish discharge
Coughing,
Loss of appetite,
Reduction in egg production among layers,
Retarded growth,
Chicken huddle together and drop as if the birds are feeling cold,
Birds standing with their eyes closed,
Presence of scores on wattles and combs.

Types of farm records
Farm diary
Farm inventory
Input records
Production records
Consumption records
Sales records
Profits and loss account
